paper.title_en: Photon Surfaces in Higher-Curvature Gravity: Implications for Quasinormal Modes and Gravitational Lensing
paper.abstract_en: Effective field theory (EFT) provides a systematic framework to describe deviations from general relativity through higher-curvature corrections to the gravitational action. In this work, we investigate test-field quasinormal modes (QNMs) and weak and strong gravitational lensing in static, spherically symmetric spacetimes with higher-curvature corrections, focusing on null geodesics near the photon sphere. Using the strong deflection limit formalism developed by Bozza, we derive the logarithmic divergence of the deflection angle and separate the divergent and regular contributions. We normalize the dimensionful EFT couplings by appropriate powers of the horizon radius $r_s=2M$ and work perturbatively in the resulting dimensionless parameters. We analyze how higher-curvature corrections modify the photon sphere radius, the critical impact parameter, and the coefficients governing the strong deflection expansion. We further examine the corresponding effects on test-field QNMs in the eikonal regime. Our results provide a systematic characterization of how higher-curvature EFT corrections modify null geodesics, strong gravitational lensing, and test-field QNMs, and clarify the relation between EFT couplings and characteristic properties of the surrounding spacetime geometry.

decision.title_zh: 高阶曲率引力中的光子面：对准正规模与引力透镜的启示
decision.abstract_zh: 有效场论（EFT）提供了一个系统框架，通过引力作用量的高阶曲率修正来描述对广义相对论的偏离。在本工作中，我们研究了具有高阶曲率修正的静态、球对称时空中的试探场准正规模（QNM）以及弱、强引力透镜，重点关注光子球附近的零测地线。利用Bozza提出的强偏折极限形式体系，我们推导了偏折角的对数发散，并将发散贡献与正则贡献分离。我们用视界半径 $r_s=2M$ 的适当幂次对量纲ful的EFT耦合进行归一化，并在由此得到的无量纲参数中进行微扰展开。我们分析了高阶曲率修正如何改变光子球半径、临界碰撞参数以及支配强偏折展开的系数。我们进一步考察了这些修正对eikonal区域中试探场QNM的相应影响。我们的结果系统刻画了高阶曲率EFT修正如何改变零测地线、强引力透镜和试探场QNM，并澄清了EFT耦合与周围时空几何特征性质之间的关系。
